prop_desc: Medical Amendment - state fund to send medical school graduates to college and require them after graduation to practice a specified time in rural areas where doctor-service is lacking; on Nov. 4 ballot
notes_endorse: Editorial opposes; says it puts the state into medicine; calls subsidizing professionals 'socialism'; says it isn't the answer to admittedly serious problem

prop_desc: Building Amendment - creates a State Building Commission with authority to erect buildings for state use; would transfer surplus from Confederate Pension Fund (~$6 million) to this purpose
notes_endorse: Building Amendment Should Be Adopted; no opposition heard; should most certainly be approved; provides roundabout solution to a pressing problem

prop_desc: Annexation of area south and west of present city limits of Corpus Christi (local referendum)

prop_desc: Annual session for the Legislature and higher pay for legislators (raise to $7,500 annual salary)

prop_desc: Would provide pensions for Rangers who retired before becoming eligible for regular state employee pensions

prop_desc: School district consolidation; technicality applicable and of interest only to Dallas County

notes_endorse: Editorial supports continuation of hospital district approach

prop_desc: Would twice raise the ceiling on state funds for aiding the needy aged, needy blind and dependent children from $47 million to $52 million annually
notes_endorse: Editorial supports raising ceilings as state's population and social problems have grown

prop_desc: New York state constitutional amendment to adopt a state revenue-producing lottery on Nov. 8 election; revenue would benefit education

prop_desc: Would consolidate state, federal and private funds for rehabilitation and vocational training of physically or mentally handicapped under the State Board of Education

prop_desc: Would authorize local voters to create a taxing airport authority in one or more counties; designed to help Dallas and Fort Worth build a regional airport for the unique twin-city area
notes_endorse: Recommended vote: FOR. We see no reason for South Texans to oppose that

notes_endorse: Recommended vote: FOR

prop_desc: Would authorize the Legislature to set up a statewide cooperative system of retirement, disability and death benefits for employees of counties and other political subdivisions; participation would be at local option, locally financed
notes_endorse: Recommended vote: FOR

notes_endorse: Recommended vote: FOR

prop_desc: Would 'repeal the poll tax as a requirement for voting'
notes_endorse: Recommended vote: AGAINST. Editorial: 'Vote AGAINST amendments No. 1 and No. 7'

notes_endorse: Editorial: Local Issues - offers a worthwhile experiment
